SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 3581.
Date 5 / 5 / 32.

Extract from Daily Intelligence Report dated 4/5/32

Anniversary of the Tsinan Incident - May 3

No attempt was made by local red adherents of the
Chinese Communist Party or other radical elements to take
advantage of the occasion of this anniversary.

〔此处转录不清：手写批注及签名，包含 "Information"、"File" 及日期 "5.5.32" 等字样〕

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处。
编号 D 3581。
日期 1932年5月5日。

摘自1932年5月4日的每日情报报告

济南惨案周年纪念——5月3日

中国共产党本地红色追随者或其他激进分子并未试图利用这一周年纪念日之机进行活动。

〔此处转录不清：手写批注及签名，包含 "Information"、"File" 及日期 "5.5.32" 等字样〕

pages.en:
Supplement to Police Intelligence Report
of May 2, 1932.

Anniversary of the Tsinan Incident Plans of adherents
of the Chinese Communist Party.

While there are no indications that adherents of the
Chinese Communist Party plan to stage demonstrations in
the Settlement tomorrow, May 3, the anniversary of the Tsinan
Incident and of the so-called Dutch East Indies Tragedy,
surreptitious dissemination of leaflets on a small scale
may be expected.
pages.zh:
1932年5月2日警察情报报告之补充。

济南惨案周年纪念日及中国共产党追随者的计划。

虽然目前没有迹象表明中国共产党追随者计划在明天，即5月3日（济南惨案及所谓荷属东印度悲剧的周年纪念日）在租界内举行示威游行，但预计会有小规模的秘密传单散发活动。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ............

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / C. & S. B. REGISTRY. / Date April 29, 1932 / No. D 3587 / Date 29. 4. 32）

Subject (in full) .... Anniversary of the Tsinan Incident, May 3.

Made by .... D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa .... Forwarded by .... **〔此处转录不清〕**

I forward herewith a communist cartoon entitled
the "Anti-Imperialist Pictorial", dated 27.4.32, purporting
to have emanated from the Propaganda Department of the Shanghai
Anti-Imperialist League, copies of which were surreptitiously
distributed in the Western District, Chinese territory, on
the afternoon of April 28.

This cartoon depicts the bombardment of Tsinan city
on May 3, 1928, urges the labouring masses to support the
Chinese Soviet Government, to declare a general strike as a
protest against Imperialism, capitalism and the Kuomintang.

A leaflet issued by the abovementioned League, copies
of which **〔此处字迹涂改〕** also surreptitiously disseminated on the afternoon
of April 28 in Chinese territory, is also attached herewith.
This leaflet contains the usual anti-Imperialist slogans and
calls upon the labouring masses to attend a mass meeting
of labour representatives to further the Anti-Imperialist
and Anti-Japanese Movement **〔此处有插入符号及小字：on May 3.〕** (venue and time not stated).

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
Supt. Robertson
(32)

Please collect further information
and submit for inclusion in Daily Intelligence
Report covering in due course.

D.I. Kuh. 288/25.
**〔此处手写签名及日期：29:4:32〕**

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号 ____ 

报告

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 刑事与特别股登记处 / 日期 1932年4月29日 / 编号 D 3587 / 日期 1932年4月29日）

主题（全称） ____  5月3日济南惨案周年纪念。

呈报人 ____  侦探督察顾宝华（Kuh Pao-hwa） ____  转呈人 ____  **〔此处转录不清〕**

现随函附上一份题为《反帝画报》的共产主义漫画，日期为1932年4月27日，据称由上海反帝同盟宣传部发出，其副本于4月28日下午在西区华界地段秘密散发。

该漫画描绘了1928年5月3日济南城遭炮击的情景，鼓动劳动群众支持中华苏维埃政府，并宣布总罢工，以抗议帝国主义、资本主义和国民党。

另附上上述同盟发布的一份传单，其副本也于4月28日下午在华界地段秘密散发 **〔此处字迹涂改〕**。该传单包含常见的反帝口号，并号召劳动群众参加劳工代表的大会，以推进反帝和抗日运动 **〔此处有插入符号及小字：于5月3日。〕**（未注明地点和时间）。

顾宝华（Kuh Pao-hwa）
侦探督察

特别处处长。
罗伯逊警司（Supt. Robertson）
(32)

请收集进一步情报，并及时提交以便纳入每日情报报告。

侦探督察顾。 288/25。
**〔此处手写签名及日期：1932年4月29日〕**
